input_values.caller_owns: Decoding, resampling, nonempty/finite validation, padding strategy and device transfer.

outputs.container: BaseModelOutput when return_dict=True; otherwise tuple of present outputs

hidden_states.semantics: Encoder input followed by states from the 12 encoder blocks.

outputs.frame_count: T(N) = floor((N - 400) / 320) + 1 for N >= 400; derived from valid convolutions.

processor.padding_policy: Caller selects padding; supplied configuration does not require padding all audio to a fixed duration.
processor.normalization: Per waveform, subtract the mean and divide by sqrt(population variance + 1e-7); the matching processor owns normalization.

frontend_and_encoder.attention_mask: Reduced from sample positions to feature frames before encoder attention.
frontend_and_encoder.native_segmentation: No fixed-duration clipping, long-track chunking or pooled-track output in forward.

adapter.window_policy: Complete-track consecutive windows; a final remainder below 400 samples is joined to the preceding window. Equal-length windows share a batch without padding.
adapter.pooling: FP32 masked time mean for each selected layer, then mean of those four pooled vectors. Accumulate track sums in CPU float64 weighted by real waveform sample counts; divide by total samples; final L2 normalization.
adapter.precision: FP32 model; CUDA native BF16 forward autocast when supported. Pooling remains FP32; other devices use FP32 forward.
